prompt_text: Who is the best roofing company in Dallas for a roof replacement?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” roofing company for everyone — the best choice depends on your needs (residential vs commercial), roof type, budget, whether you’re filing an insurance claim, and priorities like fastest timeline vs longest warranties. I can, however, help you pick a high-quality contractor and/or find top-rated Dallas companies that match your situation.

Quick guidance and next steps
- Get 3 written estimates from reputable contractors (don’t choose on price alone).
- Verify insurance and credentials: general liability, workers’ comp, and any city licenses required in your area.
- Look for manufacturer certifications (GAF Master Elite, Owens Corning Preferred, CertainTeed Select ShingleMaster) — those give better product + workmanship warranty options.
- Check reviews and complaints: Google, Yelp, Facebook, and BBB. Ask for local references and for recent photos of completed jobs.
- Confirm they handle permits, inspections, and cleanup, and will provide lien waivers upon final payment.
- Make sure the contract spells out scope, materials, start/finish dates, payment schedule, and warranty details (manufacturer vs workmanship).

Questions to ask each roofer
- Are you licensed in my city (if required) and insured? Can you provide certificates?
- Are you a certified installer for the shingle/roof system you recommend?
- Who will perform the work — your employees or subs?
- What is the exact scope of work, materials, brand/model, and warranty?
- Will you obtain permits and arrange inspections?
- What is the projected start date and completion time?
- How do you handle unforeseen damage/extra costs?
- Can I see 3 recent local references and photos?

If you want, I can:
- Look up current top-rated roofing companies in Dallas and give a short comparison.
- Review quotes you receive and help compare them line-by-line.
Tell me whether this is a residential or commercial roof, your ZIP code or neighborhood, and whether you’re using insurance — I’ll pull tailored recommendations.
